name: WPA Institute Functional Registry
policy: Every operational Institute surface must expose a real route, an explicit status, and a human-governance boundary. Informational doctrine/taxonomy sections are not required to behave like tools.

statuses.LIMITED_PRODUCTION: Function available with explicit scope limits and Human Review.
statuses.GOVERNED_PREVIEW: Preview is usable but consequential/transactional actions remain disabled.
statuses.FORMATION: Governance structure exists but membership/authority is not yet fully constituted.
statuses.FROZEN: Deliberately inactive pending legal, governance, privacy, payment or other approval.

operational_sections.purpose: Entry point to public Institute tools and research outputs.
Institutional service and briefing descriptions with public enquiry routes.
operational_sections.boundary: Paid delivery, pricing, payments and official credential issuance remain inactive/frozen pending governance and legal readiness.

operational_sections.purpose: Research, evidence and institutional measurement entry point.
Master List, benchmark and correction tools; ordinal ranking remains governed by Protocolometry readiness gates.
Discovery-to-draft research production with human review before publication.
Public reference map and benchmark workspace; not a final ranking.
Prepare practitioner-lecture briefs and route approved material into teaching/media workflows.
operational_sections.boundary: No invitation, speaker confirmation, recording right or public archive publication occurs automatically.

operational_sections.purpose: Academic Advisory Board formation, governance and independent methodological review route.
operational_sections.boundary: No person is represented as an AAB member before written acceptance; AAB advice is not journal peer review unless separately documented.

operational_sections.purpose: Submission, fee transparency and indexing-readiness guidance.
Journal policies, submissions and editorial workflow.
Human-governed institutional architecture with live status and working systems.
operational_sections.boundary: Consequential actions remain subject to the applicable Human Gate.

operational_sections.purpose: Routes Institute research into education, practice, public tools and preview systems.
operational_sections.boundary: Commerce, official credential issuance and other explicitly frozen functions remain inactive.

operational_sections.purpose: Public research outputs and DOI-linked corpus.
Public learning workspace and Virtual Sande-assisted student tools.
operational_sections.boundary: Not a final certification platform; privacy, consent and backend governance apply.

operational_sections.purpose: Routes live research, writing and media AI capabilities while marking non-live ambitions separately.
Academic search, public-source monitoring, editorial discovery and protocolometric analysis.

frozen_capabilities: official credential issuance without approved backend and Human Gate
automatic external publication where authorised platform adapters are absent
automatic AAB membership or review attribution
automatic journal acceptance or peer-review status
